### 0. Packages

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
```

### 1. Load data

```{r}
load('/home/projects/22140/exam_data/exam_functions.Rdata')
isoInfo <- read_rds('/home/projects/22140/exam_data/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.107.chr_patch_hapl_scaff_tx_info.Rds')

iso_79  <- loadIsoformCountMatrix("GSE119579,GSE119580")     # SuperSeries: use the combined ID
gene_79 <- as.matrix(extractGeneCountMatrixFromIsoCounts(iso_79))

iso_52  <- loadIsoformCountMatrix("GSE158752")     # SuperSeries: use the combined ID
gene_52 <- as.matrix(extractGeneCountMatrixFromIsoCounts(iso_52))
```

### 3. Import of datasets (from load_data) and metadata

```{r}
setwd("~/SystemsBio_project")

meta_79 <- read_excel(
  "data/GSE119579_metadata.xlsx",
  skip = 1
) |>
  as.data.frame()

rownames(meta_79) <- meta_79[["Sample Name"]]

meta_52 <- read_excel(
  "data/GSE158752_metadata.xlsx",
  skip = 1
) |>
  as.data.frame()

rownames(meta_52) <- meta_52[["Sample Name"]]
```

### 4. Checks of data

```{r}
# Set sample names as row names
rownames(meta_79) <- meta_79[["Sample Name"]]
rownames(meta_52) <- meta_52[["Sample Name"]]

# Align metadata with count matrices
meta_79 <- meta_79[colnames(gene_79), , drop = FALSE]
meta_52 <- meta_52[colnames(gene_52), , drop = FALSE]

# Check alignment
stopifnot(identical(rownames(meta_79), colnames(gene_79)))
stopifnot(identical(rownames(meta_52), colnames(gene_52)))
```

### 5. Prepare variables

```{r}
meta_79 <- meta_79 |>
  mutate(
    condition = factor(
      disease,
      levels = c("Nonasthmatic", "Asthmatic")
    ),
    sex = factor(sex),
    age = as.numeric(AGE)
  )

meta_52 <- meta_52 |>
  mutate(
    condition = factor(
      diagnosis,
      levels = c("Healthy Control", "M/M Asthma")
    ),
    sex = factor(gender),
    age = as.numeric(AGE),
    batch = factor(batch)
  )
```

### 6. Create clean metadata

```{r}
meta_79 <- data.frame(
  sample = rownames(meta_79),
  run = meta_79$Run,
  biosample = meta_79$BioSample,
  dataset = "GSE119579",
  tissue = meta_79$cell_type,
  condition = as.character(meta_79$condition),
  group = ifelse(
    meta_79$condition == "Asthmatic",
    "asthma",
    "control"
  ),
  sex = as.character(meta_79$sex),
  age = meta_79$age,
  batch = NA_character_
)

meta_52 <- data.frame(
  sample = rownames(meta_52),
  run = meta_52$Run,
  biosample = meta_52$BioSample,
  dataset = "GSE158752",
  tissue = meta_52$cell_type,
  condition = as.character(meta_52$condition),
  group = ifelse(
    meta_52$condition == "M/M Asthma",
    "asthma",
    "control"
  ),
  sex = as.character(meta_52$sex),
  age = meta_52$age,
  batch = as.character(meta_52$batch)
)
```

### 7. Check that both metadata have the same information (the count files we already know)

```{r}
identical(
  colnames(meta_79),
  colnames(meta_52)
)

str(meta_79)
str(meta_52)
```

### 8. Check NA values

```{r}
colSums(is.na(meta_79))
colSums(is.na(meta_52))
```

There aren't null values in the datasets.
